all_three_trajectories_show_real_dynamic.evidence: D1 and D2 both exceed the analytic IID-null rejection threshold for all three replicates, by 2.9x-4.5x on D1 and 3.5x-3.9x on D2.

exact_reason_rep02_failed: open-like fraction 0.130 is below the frozen 0.200 minimum; D1, D2, RMSF floor, artifact checks, and trajectory length were all satisfied.

threshold_0.20_justification.notes: No analytic derivation, citation, or literature basis found in the codebase or docs for 0.20 specifically (unlike D1/D2, which have an explicit analytic derivation). Round-number heuristic, prospectively frozen but not independently justified.

absolute_openness_thresholds_justificati.source: midpoint between two single static reference structures (1W60 apo, ligand-stripped 8GLA), fixed before any Control MD ran
absolute_openness_thresholds_justificati.notes: No MD-outcome leakage/circularity found (values predate Control-5/20 data). Statistically thin: n=1 structure per anchor class, self-disclosed in FROZEN_MD_ANALYSIS_PROTOCOL.json as 'validated only as static reference discriminator before production'.

d1_mathematically_valid.basis: Approximate large-N Gaussian rejection of IID null using Bartlett's-formula SE ~ 1/sqrt(N) for lag-1 autocorrelation of white noise; N = true analyzed frame count is the correct quantity for testing exactly that null, not pseudoreplication.

d2_mathematically_valid.basis: Half-normal expectation sqrt(2/pi)/sqrt(N) for |correlation| of IID per-atom noise; threshold = k_sigma times that expectation. Minor simplification (uses k*mean rather than mean+k*SD) does not affect any of the three replicates' conclusions given 3.5-3.9x margins.

trajectories_converged.evidence: All three replicates report convergence.overall_status = DRIFTING_BLOCKS for essentially every region and metric (RMSD, SASA, CA-hull volume) across the full 15 ns analyzed window, frequently with monotonic block means, including in the two replicates that qualified the gate.
trajectories_converged.gate_impact: None -- convergence is informational only and does not gate PASS/FAIL, correctly.

notes: Legitimate, published, real structure (RCSB 8GLA, PCNA:AOH1996-1LE co-crystal, 3.77 A, Cell Chem Biol 2023 / PMC10592352).
Ligand (AOH1996-1LE) is stripped before MD; this is an apo-from-holo-start design, a distinct hypothesis from 'does the ligand keep it open'.

50 internal residues rebuilt by PDBFixer at 3.77 A resolution, BUT confirmed (via MD_STRUCTURE_VALIDATION.json candidate_missing/candidate_residue_names) that none of the analyzed pocket residues (25-27,38-47,231-234,250-252) fall inside a rebuilt/missing region in any chain.
Conflates three distinct hypotheses (GNN positive control / MD pipeline positive control / pocket-opening reproducibility positive control) that a future protocol should separate.

failure_message_accurate.pre_patch: NO -- fixed blanket 'no dynamics' message was used even when 2 or 3 replicates positively rejected the static-noise null on D1 and D2.
failure_message_accurate.post_patch: YES -- reason now names how many replicates showed detected dynamics and why the gate still failed.

software_bugs_found.classification: SOFTWARE BUG, RESOLVED, PRE-DATES CURRENT DATA
software_bugs_found.summary: Pre-2026-08-12, gemmi-rebuilt structures lost SEQRES, so PDBFixer could not detect internal gaps in 8GLA; OpenMM then bonded flanking residues across unresolved loops (13 bonds up to 10.79 A, one at 183,222 kJ/mol strain), asymmetrically affecting only the control system.
software_bugs_found.evidence: outputs_control5/8GLA/prep/prep_audit.json shows internal_missing_residues_rebuilt=50 (correct); a hard fail-closed assert_no_impossible_bonds() now runs before every simulation build.

software_bugs_found.summary: evaluate_control_interpretability() FAIL reason was a single fixed string implying no replicate showed dynamics, even when D1/D2 were satisfied and only open-like-fraction reproducibility failed.

aggregate_replicates() used the z=1.96 large-sample approximation for the replicate-level 95% CI even at n=2-3 replicates, understating the true interval (t=4.303 needed at n=3, not 1.96). Does not affect gate PASS/FAIL (aggregate CI is descriptive only, never gates).

write_control_report() wrote to a fixed path with no stage/outdir identity recorded in the file; the only reason the Control-5 FAIL result survived Control-20 overwriting it was a manual human file copy, not an enforced mechanism.

scientific_design_problems_found.summary: 0.20 open-like-fraction floor and 0.015 nm RMSF floor are prospectively frozen but lack an analytic/literature derivation, unlike D1/D2.
SASA/hull openness thresholds derived from exactly one static structure per class (n=1), not an ensemble or distribution.
All three replicates show DRIFTING_BLOCKS through the full 15 ns analyzed window, including qualifying replicates -- 20 ns total may be an insufficient sampling horizon for this system.
GNN positive control, MD pipeline positive control, and pocket-opening reproducibility positive control are not separately named/gated hypotheses.

files_explicitly_not_modified: any gate threshold, residue definition, or replicate-requirement constant
